section.name: Compact form containers and current IR RAM data

query.name: All named-cache sink objects
query.command: histogram SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS p.sinks.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) s WHERE (s != null)

query.name: Sink objects with empty end facts
query.command: histogram SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS p.sinks.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) s WHERE (s != null AND s.endFacts.list.size = 0)

query.name: Empty end-fact list wrappers
query.command: histogram SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s.endFacts FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS p.sinks.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) s WHERE (s != null AND s.endFacts.list.size = 0)

query.name: Empty end-fact underlying ArrayLists
query.command: histogram SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s.endFacts.list FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS p.sinks.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) s WHERE (s != null AND s.endFacts.list.size = 0)

query.name: Sink objects with nonempty end facts
query.command: histogram SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS p.sinks.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) s WHERE (s != null AND s.endFacts.list.size > 0)

query.name: All edge-stage statement summaries
query.command: histogram SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS e.summary FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS p.stages.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) e WHERE (e != null AND classof(e).@name = \"org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallStage$Edges\")) s WHERE (s != null)

query.name: Edge-stage summaries with empty edges
query.command: histogram SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS e.summary FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS p.stages.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) e WHERE (e != null AND classof(e).@name = \"org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallStage$Edges\")) s WHERE (s != null AND s.edges.list.size = 0)

query.name: Edge-stage summaries with empty conjunctions
query.command: histogram SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS e.summary FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS p.stages.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) e WHERE (e != null AND classof(e).@name = \"org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallStage$Edges\")) s WHERE (s != null AND s.conjunctions.list.size = 0)

query.name: Edge-stage summaries with empty operand filters
query.command: histogram SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS e.summary FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS p.stages.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) e WHERE (e != null AND classof(e).@name = \"org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallStage$Edges\")) s WHERE (s != null AND s.typeFilters.m.size = 0)

query.name: Edge-stage summaries with empty result filters
query.command: histogram SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS e.summary FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS p.stages.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) e WHERE (e != null AND classof(e).@name = \"org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallStage$Edges\")) s WHERE (s != null AND s.resultFilters.m.size = 0)

query.name: Edge-stage summaries with all four fields empty
query.command: histogram SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS e.summary FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS p.stages.list.elementData.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS c.slots.@referenceArray FROM OBJECTS 0x7c7bf8178 c) p WHERE (p != null)) e WHERE (e != null AND classof(e).@name = \"org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.CallStage$Edges\")) s WHERE (s != null AND s.edges.list.size = 0 AND s.conjunctions.list.size = 0 AND s.typeFilters.m.size = 0 AND s.resultFilters.m.size = 0)

query.name: Current RAM storage container identity and fields
query.command: oql "SELECT s.@objectId AS storageId, toHex(s.@objectAddress) AS storageAddress, s.data.value.@objectId AS containerId, toHex(s.data.value.@objectAddress) AS containerAddress, classof(s.data.value).@name AS containerClass, s.data.value.@retainedHeapSize AS containerRetainedBytes, s.data.value.@fields AS containerFields FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.RAMEntityRelationshipStorage s"

query.name: Current RAM data direct dominator children
query.command: oql "SELECT c.@objectId AS id, toHex(c.@objectAddress) AS address, classof(c).@name AS ownerClass, c.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, dominatorof(c) AS owner FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS dominators(d) FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s.data.value FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.RAMEntityRelationshipStorage s) d) c"

query.name: Current mutable-container table headers
query.command: oql "SELECT d.@objectId AS id, toHex(d.@objectAddress) AS address, d.typeIdCounter AS nextTypeId, d.isMutable AS isMutable, d.properties AS properties, d.properties.committed.size AS committedPropertyNames, d.properties.mutated AS propertyMutation, d.links AS links, d.links.committed.size AS committedLinkNames, d.links.mutated AS linkMutation, d.blobs AS blobs, d.blobs.committed.size AS committedBlobNames, d.blobs.mutated AS blobMutation, d.instances AS instances, d.instances.committed.size AS committedEntityTypes, d.instances.mutated AS instanceMutation, d.types AS types, d.mutableEntities AS uncommittedEntities, d.mutableBlobs AS uncommittedBlobs FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS d FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s.data.value FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.RAMEntityRelationshipStorage s) d WHERE (classof(d).@name = \"org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.RAMDataContainerMutable\")) d"

query.name: Current immutable-container table headers
query.command: oql "SELECT d.@objectId AS id, toHex(d.@objectAddress) AS address, d.properties AS properties, d.properties.size AS propertyNames, d.links AS links, d.links.size AS linkNames, d.blobs AS blobs, d.blobs.size AS blobNames, d.instances AS instances, d.types AS types FROM OBJECTS (SELECT OBJECTS d FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s.data.value FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.RAMEntityRelationshipStorage s) d WHERE (classof(d).@name = \"org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.RAMDataContainerImmutable\")) d"

query.name: Current RAM properties owner union retained set
query.command: show_retained_set SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS d.properties FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s.data.value FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.RAMEntityRelationshipStorage s) d

query.name: Current RAM links owner union retained set
query.command: show_retained_set SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS d.links FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s.data.value FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.RAMEntityRelationshipStorage s) d

query.name: Current RAM blobs owner union retained set
query.command: show_retained_set SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS d.blobs FROM OBJECTS (SELECT DISTINCT OBJECTS s.data.value FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.RAMEntityRelationshipStorage s) d

section.name: IR attribute tree cardinalities including shared versions

query.name: Nonempty property trees with stored instance counts
query.command: oql "SELECT p.@objectId AS id, toHex(p.@objectAddress) AS address, p.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, p.props AS props, p.props.set.root.size AS storedInstanceValues, p.valueIndex AS optionalValueIndex FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.PropertiesMutable p WHERE (classof(p.props).@name = \"jetbrains.exodus.core.dataStructures.persistent.PersistentLong23TreeMap\" AND p.props.set.root != null)"

query.name: Property wrappers without a value index
query.command: histogram SELECT OBJECTS p FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.PropertiesMutable p WHERE (p.valueIndex = null)

query.name: Property wrappers with a value index
query.command: histogram SELECT OBJECTS p FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.PropertiesMutable p WHERE (p.valueIndex != null)

query.name: Nonempty optional value indexes with distinct-value counts
query.command: oql "SELECT p.@objectId AS propertyId, toHex(p.@objectAddress) AS propertyAddress, p.valueIndex.@objectId AS indexId, toHex(p.valueIndex.@objectAddress) AS indexAddress, p.valueIndex.@retainedHeapSize AS indexRetainedBytes, p.valueIndex.set.root.size AS distinctValues FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.PropertiesMutable p WHERE (p.valueIndex != null AND p.valueIndex.set.root != null)"

query.name: Nonempty link trees with source-instance counts
query.command: oql "SELECT l.@objectId AS id, toHex(l.@objectAddress) AS address, l.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, l.targetTypeId AS targetTypeId, l.links AS links, l.links.set.root.size AS sourceInstances FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.LinksMutable l WHERE (classof(l.links).@name = \"jetbrains.exodus.core.dataStructures.persistent.PersistentLong23TreeMap\" AND l.links.set.root != null)"

query.name: Nonempty transactional long-map committed blob counts
query.command: oql "SELECT b.@objectId AS id, toHex(b.@objectAddress) AS address, b.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, b.committed AS committed, b.committed.set.root.size AS committedBlobValues, b.mutated AS activeMutation FROM org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.TransactionalPersistentLongMap b WHERE (classof(b.committed).@name = \"jetbrains.exodus.core.dataStructures.persistent.PersistentLong23TreeMap\" AND b.committed.set.root != null)"

query.name: Immutable attribute byte buffers and stored offsets
query.command: oql "SELECT a.@objectId AS id, toHex(a.@objectAddress) AS address, a.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, a.values AS values, a.values.capacity AS valueCapacity, a.values.limit AS valueLimit, a.offsetsAndLens AS offsetsAndLens, a.offsetsAndLens.limit AS offsetsBytes, a.instanceIdCollection AS instanceIds, a.sortedByValue AS sortedByValue FROM INSTANCEOF org.opentaint.ir.impl.storage.ers.ram.AttributesImmutable a"

query.name: All rule statements with sink and action counts
query.command: oql "SELECT b.@objectId AS id, toHex(b.@objectAddress) AS address, b.@retainedHeapSize AS retainedBytes, b.sinks.list.size AS sinkAlternatives, b.summary AS summary, b.summary.edges.list.size AS summaryEdges, b.endFacts AS endFacts, b.endFacts.edges.list.size AS endEdges, b.sinks.list.elementData AS sinkArray, dominatorof(b) AS immediateDominator FROM org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.interp.RuleStatement b"
